title: Hold the trophy. Sell the story, not the vacancy.
body: If the building clears the product spec, you do not panic-mark. You lease the stack and wait for the bid to come to quality.

title: Convert the B/C that will never clear the spec.
body: Every quarter you wait, the conversion math gets worse and the carrying cost stays real. Pick a use and a capital stack.

title: Pass on 'cheap' that is actually stranded.
body: Basis is not the same as value. If power, arrival, and contiguous floors are missing, cheap is a trap.
